title: Pythagorean Theorem MicroSim
description: A MicroSim that visually demonstrates the Pythagorean Theorem by showing how the sum of the squares of the sides are are equal to square of hypotenuse.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Pythagorean
learningObjectives: State the Pythagorean relationship c² = a² + b² for the legs and hypotenuse of a right triangle
Calculate the hypotenuse length c from slider-selected leg lengths a and b and verify it against the displayed value
Explain why the square drawn on the hypotenuse has the same area as the two squares on the legs combined
Predict how lengthening leg a while holding leg b fixed changes both the hypotenuse and the area of the square on c
Identify which side of a right triangle is the hypotenuse and why it is always the longest side
